pages.title: Feather Wing
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable to: §r Elytra only$(br2)§lEffect: §r Immune to crash damage while flying with Elytra. Vanilla elytra crashes at high speed can deal heavy damage or even death — Feather Wing nullifies that damage entirely.$(br2)§lNo conflicts: §r Does not conflict with any enchantment. Can coexist with Smokeless Dash and other elytra enchantments.$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Only found in End Ship / End City loot chests (20% chance). Treasure enchantment — not available via enchanting table or villager trades.
